src: APPSC Group-II 2012
s: Who was the first Speaker (Founder) of the Andhra Pradesh State Legislative Assembly?
x:
Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao became the first Speaker of the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly after the formation of Andhra Pradesh on 1 November 1956. A veteran freedom fighter, lawyer and parliamentarian, he played a significant role in establishing the parliamentary traditions and democratic functioning of the newly formed State Legislature. Hence, the correct answer is Option (2).
Exam Note:
• First Speaker of Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly – Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao
• Andhra Pradesh Formed – 1 November 1956

s: Delimitation of the constituencies as proposed 1 in the AP Reorganization Act, 2014 can be effected through?
o: Amendment of Article 170 of the Constitution
Notification by Central Government is enough
Passing of resolution by the respective assemblies
x: Sec. 26 proposes raising seats to 225 (AP) and 153 (Telangana), but Art. 170(3) freezes seat numbers until the first Census after 2026, so an earlier increase needs a constitutional amendment (of Art. 170). A mere Central notification or assembly resolutions cannot do it.
